LanguageData.RT_T14_MainBattleTank_Blueprint.label: T-14 "Armata"
LanguageData.RT_T14_MainBattleTank_Blueprint.descript:
The T-14 "Armata" main battle tank is a new generation of main battle tank in the Russian Federation, with unparalleled protection and advanced digital command system. The Unmanned turret is equipped with the invincible 2A82 main gun.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Commander x1
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
125mmNG（Main Gun）
12.7x108mm（Top MG）
30x165mm（Coaxial Gun）
